title: Newsroom
description: A premium newsroom hub for Star Atlas that organizes updates, editorial channels, and community signals without feeling stale or overloaded.
heroTitle: Updates should feel curated, current, and easy to trust.
heroSummary: This newsroom template avoids the feeling of a cluttered archive by grouping content by purpose: release notes, economy signals, worldbuilding, and company context.
utilityLine: The page is designed so only genuinely current items should be featured prominently. Evergreen categories stay visible; stale stories should fall back quietly.

heroMedia.label: Editorial hub
heroMedia.caption: A newsroom should guide attention instead of making every update compete equally.

heroPanel.title: Freshness is a trust issue, not just a content issue.
heroPanel.body: The redesign gives this page a structure that can promote what is current while quietly de-emphasizing stale material that weakens confidence.
bullets: Featured area reserved for current content only
Evergreen categories separated from time-sensitive updates
Clear exits into roadmap, support, and community channels

sections.heading: Organize the newsroom by user intent.

cards.title: Release notes and launch updates
cards.body: Use this stream for what changed, what opened, and what visitors should try next.

cards.title: Economic reports and market context
cards.body: Keep the signals high-value and recent so the page supports trust instead of noise.

cards.title: Dispatches and worldbuilding
cards.body: Editorial storytelling should deepen the premium feel without blocking action.

sections.heading: What belongs in the featured area and what should quietly archive.
body: Only current, decision-relevant updates should get hero placement. Old campaigns, outdated launch states, and stale status claims should lose visual prominence quickly.
That keeps the newsroom from undermining the premium experience the rest of the site works to build.
sections.asideTitle: Use the newsroom as a confidence surface.
sections.asideBody: Every featured card should answer why the visitor should care right now.

cards.title: Roadmap page
cards.body: A clearer status page for what is playable now, what is expanding next, and what remains long-term.

cards.title: Contact and help
cards.body: Visitors should always know where to go when they need answers or issue resolution.

cards.title: Discord
cards.body: Community conversation remains important, but the site now labels this clearly as a separate destination.

finalCta.title: Keep the update flow clear and current.
finalCta.text: From here, move into the roadmap for status clarity or into support and community channels for direct engagement.
